claims.text: Multiple baselines were tested, including a majority-class baseline and various neural models like Bert and SVM.
The performance of strong neural baselines was compared against human performance, indicating the effectiveness of the tested models.
Different feature sets were used in the SVM baseline to improve performance over a majority-class baseline.
